summary: Iteration 6 — RE-TEST after iteration_5 fixes. RESULT: 20/20 PASS (100%). All Phase C (public hub chat + lead capture) and Phase D (EAN enrichment) tests now pass, plus full regression. Bug #1 fix verified: replacing @limiter.limit with manual _ip_rate_limit_check helper correctly resolves the slowapi/FastAPI 422 body-parsing issue — chat returns 200 with session_id+reply when Pro, 402 when free, 404 for invalid slug. Bug #2 fix verified: User-Agent 'etoh-pilot/1.0 (contact@etoh.fr)' on the OpenFoodFacts call makes EAN 3017620422003 return Nutella product correctly (200 with name='Nutella', brand='Nutella, Yum yum', image_url present). Lead capture works: consent=true creates prospect with id pr_*, consent=false returns 400. Full regression of /api/, /api/auth/me, /api/subscription/plans, /api/admin/health, /api/wallet/packs, /api/hub/me all green. Mongo state cleanly reverted at teardown (subscription unset, 0 leftover prospects/sessions).
action_items: Phases C & D are GREEN — main agent can proceed to Phase E.
Minor: server.py is now 3300+ lines; consider splitting /api/public/hub routes into a separate router before Phase E (already flagged in iteration_5 code review).
Minor: bcrypt passlib warning 'module bcrypt has no attribute __about__' appears in backend logs (cosmetic, hashing still works). Pin bcrypt==4.0.1 or upgrade passlib to silence.
critical_code_review_comments: _ip_rate_limit_check correctly handles X-Forwarded-For (added during this iteration) because the K8s ingress rotates between two proxy pod IPs (10.208.138.130 / 133); without XFF the rate-limit bucket was split per proxy and the 10/min cap was effectively 20/min. The previous iteration's fix using only request.client.host would silently let real clients double their quota in production behind any LB that rotates source IPs — IMPORTANT to keep the XFF logic.

Per-IP rate limiter uses an in-memory defaultdict — if backend scales beyond 1 worker, buckets diverge per worker. For production, move to Redis-backed counter (current: --workers 1 in supervisor, so OK for now).
Hub chat endpoint still synchronously calls OpenAI inside the request path (no streaming). Acceptable for short replies but consider Server-Sent Events for Phase E if users complain about latency.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase C & D tests are stable at 20/20. Note: the rate-limit test (TestZZRateLimit) must remain the LAST class in the file — the per-IP sliding window is 60s and prior chat tests consume the budget. If a future iteration adds more chat tests before TestZZRateLimit, either move it to its own file or insert a `time.sleep(61)` before it. Also, the _ip_rate_limit_check now honors X-Forwarded-For — when adding more public/anonymous endpoints, follow the same pattern (don't rely solely on request.client.host behind the K8s ingress).
